summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan to eliminate text flickering across the site and execute a full responsive mobile layout overhaul.
- Fixes font rendering, subpixel shifting, transition double-fade conflicts, and transform jitter in CSS, Hero, Project Cards, and Admin traffic stream.
- Re-architects mobile layout across Navigation drawer, Hero viewport, Gallery category filter bar, Project cards grid, Video modal, and Admin dashboard for flawless display on all mobile screen widths (320px–768px).
